newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close down on cash shortage.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close down on cash shortage.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed down on Wednesday on a shortage of cash, dealers said.

The shortage followed the siphoning off of more than 6.03 billion rupees in the form of payment of rights issues of ICI Pakistan by December 4, the last date of payments, dealer Mushrraf Iqbal at the Karachi Stock Exchange said.
The Karachi 100-share index closed 7.06 points, or 0.50 percent, down at 1,409.63 amid 197 losers and 40 gainers.
The index resisted falling below 1,406, Iqbal said. ICI fell 1.05 rupees to 20.70, Parke-Davis 15 to 570, Lever Brothers 6.00 to 659 and PSO 3.00 to 362. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
